summary: Iteration 12 verification of 5 new features + regression. BACKEND: 46/46 pytest passing (added test_health_score_history.py — week 7pts, month 30pts, deterministic, default=week). New endpoint GET /api/v1/dashboard/health-score-history returns 200 for both ranges. FRONTEND (all verified against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): (1) App Settings modal opens from Profile, Units segmented control toggles metric<->imperial and immediately updates displays app-wide — Dashboard metric-card-weight switches to '127.9 lbs', metric-card-water to '25 oz', profile-height-value to 5'5", profile-weight-card to 127.9 lbs, activity-tile-distance to '5.6 mi'; reverting to Metric restores kg/km/ml. localStorage keys vitality_unit_system/vitality_notif_hydration/vitality_notif_streaks/vitality_notif_weekly_digest all persist. Version footer reads 'Vitality v1.2.0-emerge'. (2) Health Score History chart renders inside HealthScoreModal from Profile 'Health Score History' — SVG chart present, Week (7-day avg 84/100) and Month (30-day avg 84/100) toggles switch data, hover tooltip shows date+score (e.g., '8/17 85'). (3) Macro Balancer badge: with no nutrition log today shows 'Locked' + subtitle 'Log balanced carbs, protein and fat today to unlock'; after POST /api/v1/nutrition/logs with mealType='BREAKFAST' foodName carbs=300 protein=200 fat=100 the badge live-updates to 'Unlocked' with subtitle 'Carbs 100% · Protein 100% · Fat 100% of daily targets' and Milestone Unlocked celebration fires. Other 5 badges (10k-club, hydration-hero, mindful-master, mindful-streak, 7-day-streak) still render with correct statuses. (4) Weekly Digest Sunday Nudge: with localStorage.vitality_force_weekly_nudge='true' and vitality_notif_weekly_digest='true', after ~9s an app-toast appears reading 'Your Weekly Digest is ready! Tap to view your wins.' with a 'View' action button; clicking action opens WeeklyDigestModal. With vitality_notif_weekly_digest='false' the nudge is correctly suppressed. Cleanup performed. (5) Share on X button present in Weekly Digest modal; clicking it calls window.open with 'https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Crushed%2064%2C490%20steps%20and%204%20mindfulness%20sessions%20this%20week%20on%20%23VitalityApp!...' (contains steps count + #VitalityApp hashtag). Regression: Dashboard steps=11,690, Activity page loads OK.

issues: The three notification toggle switches expose no aria-checked (or role=switch) attribute — DOM inspection returned aria-checked=None. Functional persistence works via localStorage but assistive-tech users can't determine on/off state. Consider adding role=switch + aria-checked.
Pressing Escape does not close the BottomSheet modals — user must click the X button or backdrop. Minor UX consistency issue.

action_items: Optional: add role=switch + aria-checked to Settings toggle components for a11y.
Optional: add Escape-to-close handler to BottomSheet (consistency with common modal patterns).
critical_code_review_comments: AchievementsModal.tsx: badges useMemo depends on `macro` (nutrition?.macroBreakdown). If the badges array is first computed before the useNutritionLogs query resolves, the subtitle falls back to the empty-state copy while status could later flip to Unlocked on next render — verified end-state renders correctly with 100/100/100 percentages after data lands, so no actual UI bug, but the initial 1-tick mismatch (subtitle=empty, status=Unlocked or vice-versa) is theoretically observable in a slow-network first paint. Consider gating the whole badge render on `nutrition` loaded.

New endpoint /api/v1/dashboard/health-score-history is unauthenticated (like all other /dashboard endpoints in this demo scope) — deterministic seeded pseudo-random walk confirmed (test_health_score_history_deterministic passes).
Share on X: buildTweetText correctly encodes steps count and #VitalityApp hashtag; window.open call verified via intercept.
test_credentials: Demo login via 'Continue as Grace' button on /login — no creds required.
seed_data_creation: Posted 1 nutrition log for today (mealType=BREAKFAST, foodName='Test Meal', carbs=300g, protein=200g, fat=100g) to verify Macro Balancer 'Unlocked' path.
